Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and subsequent headaches,
dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism and force of the collision are consistent with the injury
described. Over the course of 17 visits, care included symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive rest guidance,
graded return-to-activity planning, and supportive therapy. Recovery has taken somewhat longer than is typical for a
concussion of this kind. Most of the documented complaints are based on the patient's own reoprts of pain and
smyptom severity, as neurological examination findings and imaging have been within normal limits. The patient also
reported a minor strain to the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation.
Bliling entries for two similar services on the same date are under review for accuracy. Continued follow-up is planned
to reassess symptoms and functional capacity.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
